data.gender_notes: Herrmann is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Herrmann is derived from the Old German words hari, meaning 'army' or 'ruler', and man, meaning 'man'. This name was commonly given to boys in German-speaking regions during the Middle Ages, reflecting the strong military and leadership connotations of the name. The name Herrmann carries the meaning “Man, ruler” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, German. Parents who choose Herrmann usually hope their child will grow to embody man, ruler and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Herrmann total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
